rules.failure_behavior: STOP when a dependency cannot be resolved or classified.
rules.predicate: Entrypoint seed or transitive repository-local runtime dependency.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP when a referenced command, script, configuration, or asset is unresolved.
rules.predicate: Governed production launcher or startup-health entrypoint and all referenced files.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP when any discovered test lacks deterministic inclusion or governed exclusion.
rules.predicate: Discovered test imports, references, executes, fixtures, or governs selected production behavior.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP when a selected test dependency or fixture is unresolved.
rules.predicate: Transitive repository-local dependency or fixture of a selected production test.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP when registered evidence is missing, inaccessible, or changes during binding.
rules.predicate: Explicit evidence required to reconstruct or verify the captured production state.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP when authority, generator identity, or source relationship is absent.
rules.predicate: Generated artifact explicitly designated authoritative for production recovery.

evidence_required: same relevance rules as tracked files
rules.failure_behavior: STOP when an untracked file is omitted merely because it is untracked.
rules.predicate: Untracked path meeting any inclusion rule or requiring explicit governed exclusion.

evidence_required: same relevance rules as tracked files
rules.failure_behavior: STOP when an ignored path is silently absent from classification.
rules.predicate: Ignored path meeting an inclusion rule or separately inventoried by an exclusion rule.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP if mutable state is read or copied without separate authorization.
rules.predicate: Runtime database, journal, live state, or mutable operational data.

evidence_required: path, size, SHA-256, authority and immutability
rules.failure_behavior: STOP when a required external dependency is unresolved or unbound.
rules.predicate: Required runtime dependency located outside the repository root.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP if runtime or test closure reaches a path classified as backup.
rules.predicate: Path under an exact governed backup root and not selected by dependency closure.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP if a selected dependency matches an exclusion or a pattern overreaches.
rules.predicate: Narrowly matched cache, temporary, IDE, editor, browser-profile, or build output.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP if a recovery-critical log is excluded instead of content-bound.
rules.predicate: Log not explicitly designated as required capture or verification evidence.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP if a required capture record is excluded as generic governance material.
rules.predicate: Governance document unrelated to the active disk-state identity; separately inventoried.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP if evidence or rationale is absent or if a conflicting exclusion applies.
rules.predicate: Exact registry entry accepted as a governed seed; never a replacement for derivation.

rules.failure_behavior: STOP unless the exclusion is deterministic, evidence-backed, and conflict-free.
rules.predicate: Exact or narrowly patterned exclusion accepted through the governed registry.
